records.name: THE GRAND HOTEL
records.use: hotel; ground floor has modern shop fronts
records.field_evidence: Historic England identifies the listed building as The Grand Hotel on Granby Street; the official description says it is a large four-storey corner building, and the ground floor is taken up by modern shop fronts.

records.name: 2 ST MARTINS
records.field_evidence: Historic England's official list entry identifies 2 St Martins as a former bank, built 1900-1902 for Pares's Bank.

records.name: CHURCH OF ST PETER
records.field_evidence: Historic England's official list entry identifies Church of St Peter on St Peter's Road; the entry describes an 1872-79 Gothic-style church.
